title: Messaging — Mux Event — payload
description: A live, unstored event from a mediator to the principal of one mux connection: the connection is ready (with its nonce and limits), members attached or detached, or an inbound frame for a member refused. The members present depend on `event`; see the specification. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

event.description: Which event this is. Each kind carries the members the specification lists for it, and no others.

sessionId.description: `ready` only, REQUIRED: this connection's identifier, which attach statements sign over.

muxNonce.description: `ready` only, REQUIRED: this connection's nonce, which attach statements sign over.

maxDidsPerConnection.description: `ready` only, REQUIRED: the most members this connection may carry.

maxGrantLifetimeSeconds.description: `ready` only, REQUIRED: the longest `exp − iat` a grant may have.

maxAttachLifetimeSeconds.description: `ready` only, OPTIONAL: the longest an attach statement's `exp` may lie after its `iat`.

sessionExpiresAt.description: `ready` only, OPTIONAL: when the principal's authentication of this connection expires and the connection closes. An attach statement's `exp` may not be later.

pendingNotices.description: `ready` only, REQUIRED: how many messaging/mux/notice documents wait in the principal's inbox. Non-zero means the principal must drain them before it trusts its member set.

dids.description: `attached` and `detached` only, REQUIRED: the members that changed, batched. A larger change is split across several events.

frameId.description: `refused` only, REQUIRED: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the refused frame's exact bytes — the identifier `tsp-ack` already uses.

sender.description: `refused` only, OPTIONAL: the frame's sender, when the mediator could read it.

receiver.description: `refused` only, OPTIONAL: the member DID or principal the frame was addressed to, when the mediator could read it.

code.description: `refused` only, REQUIRED: the mediator's stable refusal code, the same code a traffic-monitor `refused` event reports.

reason.description: `refused` only, OPTIONAL: a short human-readable explanation. Never message content.

MemberChange.title: MemberChange
MemberChange.description: One member's change in an `attached` or `detached` event.

reason.description: Why the member changed: an AttachReason value in an `attached` event, a DetachReason value in a `detached` event.

grantId.description: The grant concerned, where the member is or was attached through one.

scope.description: `attached` only: the scope now in force for the member.

expiresAt.description: `attached` only: when the membership lapses unless renewed.

deliveryActive.description: `attached` only: false while the member DID's own direct connection keeps its live traffic.
